quests.name: Devourer of Souls
quests.text: Speak with Godrick Farsan in the Temple of the Damned.

quests.name: Hearts of the Pure
quests.text: Bring the hearts of Dalin Forgewright and Comar Villard to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.

quests.name: WRIGGLE.
quests.text: Purchase Nutritious Slime Sludge and return to your befriended excitable slime. If it seems tired, try dancing with it again to catch its attention.

quests.name: Investigate the Scourge of the Undercity
quests.text: Collect three Dim Necrotic Stones from the Scourge outside the Undercity and investigate the glowing runic circles near their encampment.

quests.name: The Lich's Identity
quests.text: Bring the Lich's Spellbook to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.text: Using the Runes of Summoning, summon and subdue a voidwalker, then return the Runes of Summoning to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Creature of the Void
quests.text: Recover Egalin's Grimoire and bring it to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.

quests.name: The Balnir Farmstead
quests.text: Bring Balnir Snapdragons to Anastasia Hartwell in the Mage Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Hex of Weakness
quests.text: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: A Lesson in Divinity
quests.text: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.

quests.name: A Lesson in Divinity
quests.text: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.

quests.name: The Deathstalkers
quests.text: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.

quests.name: The Deathstalkers
quests.text: Speak with Andron Gant in the Undercity.

quests.name: The Deathstalkers
quests.text: Bring Andron's Ledger to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of Undercity.

quests.name: The Deathstalkers
quests.text: Deliver Andron's Ledger to Varimathras in the Hall of the Dark Lady in the Undercity.

quests.name: Sample for Helbrim
quests.text: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.

quests.name: Zinge's Delivery
quests.text: Bring the Wolf Heart Samples to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

quests.name: Gathering Materials
quests.text: Bring 10 Linen Cloth and 6 Dalaran Mana Gems to Josef Gregorian.

quests.name: Prompt Potion Runner
quests.text: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.

quests.name: Investigate the Alchemist Shop
quests.text: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment Coffers from behind Anastasia Hartwell. Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers, the Chest of Containment Coffers and the Cantation of Manifestation to Anastasia in the Undercity.

quests.name: Fenwick Thatros
quests.text: Kill Fenwick Thatros and bring his head back to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Find the Shattered Hand
quests.text: Journey to Orgrimmar and speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow.

quests.name: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works
Tools of the Trade
quests.text: Find the Dalaran Status Report and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.text: Using the Pure Hearts, summon and subdue a succubus, then return the Pure Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Shadowguard
quests.text: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Hearts of the Lovers
quests.text: Bring the hearts of Avelina Lilly and Isaac Pearson to Carendin Halgar in the Temple of the Damned.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.text: Using the Lovers' Hearts, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Lovers' Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.text: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.

quests.name: Speak with Deino
quests.text: Speak with Deino.

quests.name: Dragonmaw Shinbones
quests.text: Bring 8 Sturdy Dragonmaw Shinbones to Velora Nitely in the Undercity.

quests.name: Tome of the Cabal
quests.text: Retrieve the Moldy Tome and Tattered Manuscript for Jorah Annison in the Undercity.

quests.name: Tome of the Cabal
quests.text: Bring the Reconstructed Tome and 3 Rods of Channeling to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

quests.name: Seeking Strahad
quests.text: Find Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

quests.name: In Search of Menara Voidrender
quests.text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: Thundering Hearts
quests.text: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.

quests.name: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends
Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead
A Ludite's Guide to Caring for Your Demonic Pet
Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
quests.text: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

quests.name: To Steal From Thieves
quests.text: Bring Kenata, Fardel, and Marcel Dabyrie's Heads to Genavie Callow in Undercity.

quests.name: The Crown of Will
quests.text: Report to Melisara at Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

quests.name: Summon Felsteed
quests.text: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

quests.name: Report to Danitha
quests.text: Speak with Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.

quests.name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart
quests.text: Bring the items on Bel'dugur's Note to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.

quests.name: Greater Friend of the Library
quests.text: You will need to hand in 25 books to complete this quest, however you can hand 1 in at any time.

quests.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
quests.text: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.

quests.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
quests.text: Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

quests.name: A Lesson in Literacy
quests.text: Track down and collect the spellbook materials requested by the librarian.

quests.name: Return to Apothecary Zinge
quests.text: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

quests.name: Goblin Engineering
quests.text: If you wish to learn more about Goblin Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Gnome Engineering
quests.text: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Lines of Communication
quests.text: Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity wants you to travel to the Hinterlands and burn the Highvale Records, Highvale Report, and Highvale Notes.

quests.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
quests.text: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Seeping Corruption
quests.text: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

quests.name: Seeping Corruption
quests.text: Give Cuely's Elixir to Thersa Windsong in Undercity.

quests.name: A Sample of Slime...
quests.text: Gather Felwood Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Felwood. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most corrupt. Bring 5 of the Corrupted Felwood Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

quests.name: The Jeremiah Blues
quests.text: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone. If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

quests.name: Melding of Influences
quests.text: Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in Undercity.

quests.name: The New Frontier
quests.text: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of Kalimdor.

quests.name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
quests.text: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater. Then, using the Testing Equipment next to Chemist Fuely in Undercity, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to Chemist Fuely.

quests.name: The Champion of the Banshee Queen
quests.text: Speak with Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.

quests.name: The Horde Needs Your Help!
quests.text: Speak with Warlord Gorchuk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.

quests.name: Lunar Fireworks
quests.text: Launch 8 Lunar Fireworks and 2 Cluster Fireworks and return to a Lunar Festival Harbinger at any capital city.

quests.name: The Lunar Festival
quests.text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Park District in Stormwind. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

quests.name: The Lunar Festival
quests.text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

quests.name: The Lunar Festival
quests.text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the entrance to the Undercity. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

quests.name: The Lunar Festival
quests.text: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger at the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.

quests.name: Valadar Starsong
quests.text: Use your Lunar Festival Invitation in the moonlight to travel to Moonglade. Speak with Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven when you arrive.

quests.name: Dangerous Love
quests.text: Get a Guardian's Moldy Card and bring it to Fenstad Argyle in the Undercity.

quests.name: Fenstad's Hunch
quests.text: Bring 1 Cologne Bottle and 1 Perfume Bottle to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity's Apothecarium.

quests.name: Zinge's Assessment
quests.text: Return to Fenstad Argyle outside the bank in the Undercity.

quests.name: Tracing the Source
quests.text: Speak with Innkeeper Norman in the Undercity.

quests.name: Tracing the Source
quests.text: Speak with Mara Rennick at the tailor's shop in the Undercity's Mage Quarter.

quests.name: The Source Revealed
quests.text: Find Apothecary Staffron Lerent in the Hillsbrad Foothills past Ravenholdt Manor.

quests.name: Faint Necrotic Crystal
quests.text: Bring the Faint Necrotic Crystal to Lieutenant Rukag in the courtyard of the Undercity.

quests.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
quests.text: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Chicken Clucking for a Mint
quests.text: Do a chicken emote at Innkeeper Norman, and in exchange you'll receive an Undercity Mint!
